Errors & retries

Make failures understandable and retries deliberate.

SignalWhat to checkNext step
400Request schema or unsupported parameterCorrect the request before retrying.
401 / 403Credential or access permissionsCheck the account and model access.
429Rate or capacity limitRespect Retry-After if present; use backoff.
5xxService or upstream failureRetry with bounded backoff when safe.
TimeoutUnknown request outcomeCheck job or request status before resubmitting.

Avoid duplicate generation

A timeout does not prove that no work was started. For asynchronous jobs, check the recorded job identifier before creating another request. Use an idempotency mechanism only if the endpoint explicitly supports it.

Keep enough context to investigate

Record the timestamp, model ID, HTTP status and request ID. Remove API keys and sensitive input content from logs and support reports.
